goal: gate-impl FAIL outputを構造化されたObservation/NextActionとして扱い、AIと人間が追加のspec/guardrail再読なしで次の修正対象を特定できるようにする。

analysis.problem: 現在のgate-impl FAILは自然文reasonにflattenされ、修正対象、根拠、severity、次アクションが再構成を必要とする。さらにprior FAILの判断が次roundへ継承されず、抽象的なguardrail本文がdiff検証できないblocking判定を生みやすい。
analysis.proposedApproach: gate-implを起点にObservation、Diagnosis、NextActionのクラスとwire形式を導入し、gate result、issue-log、consumer promptの読み口をNextAction中心へ寄せる。あわせてprior FAIL memoryをpromptへ注入し、base presetのno-overengineering/code-placementをdiff検証可能な条件へ書き換える。
analysis.validation: Issue #341はfailureMode enum、wire形式、対象ファイル、完了条件を明示している。現行コードにはrun-gate.jsのreasonsFromEvaluations、failedEvaluations、gate.schema.jsonの単純なverdict/issues形式、base guardrailの抽象本文があり、Issueが述べる問題と変更対象が一致している。

knownFacts: Issue #341 defines the goal as replacing natural-language gate-impl FAIL reasons with structured Observation/NextAction output.
Issue #341 limits direct root-cause mitigation to prior FAIL memory and rewriting no-overengineering/code-placement; cross-flow learning is explicitly out of scope.

src/flow/lib/run-gate.js exports buildGuardrailArticleEvalPrompt, parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation, assertNoRepeatedFail, and reasonsFromEvaluations, and currently persists failedEvaluations into issue-log entries.
src/flow/schemas/next-action/gate.schema.json currently documents only verdict plus issues, so gate-level NextAction needs schema coverage.
src/presets/base/guardrail.json currently defines code-placement and no-overengineering in broad prose rather than diff-verifiable violation conditions.
src/flow/prompts/impl/gate-impl.md currently tells agents to read data.artifacts.reasons on FAIL, so consumer instructions must shift to nextAction.diagnosis.observations.
decisionPoints: How invalid AI Observation output should be handled when parsing detects enum, requirementRef, or required-field violations.
What exact prior FAIL memory unit, status source, and pruning rule should be used for gate-impl prompt injection.
Where to store the reusable rubric for rewriting abstract guardrails into diff-verifiable conditions.
How legacy adapters should represent missing fields for unmigrated phases without inventing evidence.
resolvedByProjectRules: Use classes for Observation, Diagnosis, and NextAction because project rules require meaningful structural values to be represented by dedicated classes with invariants and behavior.
Do not keep backward compatibility shims for old persistence formats because the project is in alpha and explicitly discards deprecated formats.
Do not add external dependencies; schema and validation work must use existing project utilities or Node.js built-ins.
Update generated skills/config with sdd-forge upgrade if src/skills or src/presets templates are changed; this issue changes src/presets/base/guardrail.json, so upgrade impact must be checked.
requiresUserJudgment: No unresolved user judgment remains after draft-refine.
deferredToSpec: Exact requirement numbering and task decomposition for class model, run-gate changes, schema/persistence changes, prompt updates, guardrail rewrites, and tests.
Exact field names for adapter-created null or empty values where legacy phases lack rich Observation information.
Precise test matrix for unit, spec-local, flow gate, upgrade, and regression coverage.

in: must: gate-impl FAIL artifact shape and consumer read path
must: Observation/Diagnosis/NextAction in-memory classes and JSON conversion

must: gate-impl failureMode enum contains spec-impl-mismatch, guardrail-violation, and process-evidence-missing; spec-impl-mismatch and guardrail-violation are always blocking, while process-evidence-missing is blocking only when diff-verifiable and advisory otherwise
must: issue-log persistence from failedEvaluations to observations

must: prior FAIL memory for same-flow same-phase gate-impl evaluation stores the last 3 rounds; flow.json stores version, artifactPath, roundsKept, lastUpdatedAt, entries[].signature, entries[].status, and entries[].observationRef; the artifact stores full Observation, statusReason, round, and updatedAt

must: legacy adapter converts unmigrated phase evaluations to NextAction without phase-specific branches; fields unavailable in the legacy input are represented only as null, empty string, or empty array according to the Observation JSON field type

must: base preset no-overengineering lists single-caller indirection, duplicate code shape, and design-confirmation evidence as separate diff-verifiable violation conditions; code-placement lists derivation logic placed in a consumer module as a diff-verifiable violation condition

must: add spec-local tests under specs/266-structured-gate-fail/tests with // spec: R<N> headers, update shared tests whose assertions read artifacts.reasons, artifacts.evaluations, artifacts.issues, or failedEvaluations, and run sdd-forge upgrade after src/presets/base changes
out: cross-flow learning between unrelated specs or historical flows
similarity algorithm improvements beyond the field rename needed for Observation
full preset-wide guardrail rewrite across every preset

impactOnExisting: Existing gate consumers that read artifacts.reasons/evaluations/issues must move to artifacts.nextAction.diagnosis.observations.
Existing issue-log entries in new flows should use observations rather than failedEvaluations; old alpha persistence does not need compatibility.
Base guardrail wording changes can affect task-impl and integration gate evaluations for every preset inheriting base guardrails.
Prompt behavior for gate-impl changes because prior FAIL memory and structured JSON examples are added to the evaluator context.

qa.question: AIがObservationの不正JSONを返した場合の扱いを選んでください。Observationはgate-impl FAILの構造化1件で、failureMode、requirementRef、where、observedを持ちます。
qa.answer: 再生成 retry を採用する。不正な Observation JSON は parse/constructor invariant で検出し、既存gate retry maxAttemptsの残数を1回消費してAIに再生成させる。再生成後も不正な場合は通常のgate retry exhaustionと同じ停止扱いにする。
qa.evidence: Issue #341 unresolved (f) lists invalid failureMode, unknown requirementRef, and missing required fields as parse-time errors detected by the Observation constructor; user selected option [1] on 2026-05-22.
qa.why: 不正なAI出力を構造だけ再生成させれば、blocking/advisory の意味を実装側で勝手に変更せずに済む。既存gate retry maxAttemptsを使うことで、新しい未定義のretry枠を増やさずに検証可能になる。
qa.considered: Envelope.failは安全だが軽微なJSON不整合でも人間判断に戻りやすい。Force advisoryは継続性は高いが、blocking条件を検証不能という理由で弱めるリスクがある。

qa.question: gate-impl prior memoryの粒度を選んでください。prior memoryは同じflow内の過去FAILを次のgate-impl promptへ渡す情報です。
qa.answer: 直近3 roundのObservation全体とresolution statusをgate-impl prior memoryとして渡す。
qa.evidence: Issue #341 section F lists prior FAIL observations, resolution status, and pruning as open implementation details; user selected option [1] on 2026-05-22.
qa.why: Observation本文とresolution statusを渡すことで、AIが同じviolationを再flagすべきでない根拠を理解できる。直近3 roundに絞ることで、全件投入よりprompt量を抑えつつ、直近のFAIL→fix→retry文脈を保持できる。
qa.considered: signatureのみはtoken効率が高いが、AIが過去判断の意味を復元しにくい。全Observationは情報量が最大だが、長いflowでpromptが膨らむ。

qa.question: prior memoryのresolution statusをどこから導出するか選んでください。resolution statusは過去FAILがfixed、acknowledged-as-exception、unresolvedのどれかを示す値です。
qa.answer: issue-logはflow挙動の入力に使わない。gate-impl prior memoryはflow.jsonと専用artifactに分ける。flow.jsonにはversion、artifactPath、roundsKept、lastUpdatedAt、entries[].signature、entries[].status、entries[].observationRefのみを保持する。専用artifactにはObservation詳細、statusReason、round、updatedAtなどのprompt材料と履歴を保持する。
qa.evidence: User clarified on 2026-05-22 that issue-log is only a log and should not drive flow behavior, then approved option [1] flow.json + artifact after reviewing the proposed field split.
qa.why: flow.jsonはflow進行状態のsource of truthであり、次のgate-impl挙動に使う現在状態を置く場所として自然。Observation全文や履歴をすべてflow.jsonへ入れると進行状態と詳細証跡が混ざるため、詳細は専用artifactへ分離する。
qa.considered: issue-log利用は監査ログを挙動入力にしてしまうため却下。flow.jsonのみは単純だが肥大化しやすい。専用artifactのみは詳細管理に向くが、flowの現在状態から参照しにくい。

qa.question: 抽象guardrailを書き換えるreusable rubricの保存場所を選んでください。reusable rubricは、no-overengineering/code-placementで使うdiff検証可能化の書き換え型です。
qa.answer: reusable rubricはsrc/presets/base配下に保存する。
qa.evidence: Issue #341 G-3 requires recording the rewrite pattern as a reusable rubric and leaves the location as docs/ or src/presets/base/; user selected option [1] on 2026-05-22.
qa.why: no-overengineering/code-placementの本文と同じ配布対象に置くことで、npm利用者にもguardrail書き換え基準を届けられる。src/presets/baseの変更はsdd-forge upgradeで反映対象になるため、base presetとrubricの同期リスクも下げられる。
qa.considered: docs配下は設計文書として読みやすいが、自動生成領域との境界に注意が必要。spec内のみは今回の計画には残るが、後続のguardrail rewrite taskで再利用されにくい。

approval.notes: All draft QA entries are answered and draft coverage review passed.
